finalists.label: Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including extensive epidermal necrosis with acantholysis and large multinucleated keratinocytes with ballooning degeneration.

finalists.label: Pneumonia
finalists.why: It is directly mentioned in the vignette as a hospitalization reason, but it does not account for the skin findings.

finalists.label: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation
finalists.why: It is not directly supported by the vignette, which lacks findings of widespread clotting.

finalists.label: Varicella-like rash due to other viruses
finalists.why: It is not supported by the negative RT-PCR testing for SARS-CoV-2 and lack of other viral evidence.

frontier_selector.why: Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis is chosen over Stevens-Johnson Syndrome due to its more specific skin findings, including extensive epidermal necrosis with acantholysis and large multinucleated keratinocytes with ballooning degeneration, which are more decisive in the vignette.
